title: Radioactive cesium-137 removal from contaminated wastewater using bio-based activated carbon from cassava rhizomes enhanced with copper hexacyanoferrate
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,6217-6232
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08444J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kanyanat Tawatbundit, Sudarat Issarapanacheewin, Witsanu Katekaew, Nikom Prasertchiewchan, Wilasinee Kingkam, Poonnaphob Sopapan
The CuHCF/CRAC composite exhibits an impressive efficiency of 99.15% in the adsorption of Cs‑137. The findings emphasize the various mechanisms at play in the capture of Cs‑137 and validate the material's potential for reusability across five cycles.
